widget.doc: A music player with drawn album art: NowPlaying =playing title:"Midnight City" artist:"M83" kind:"vinyl" tone:"lilac" elapsed:=t length:243 -> i=result=="next"?i+1:i-1 (the center button flips your playing variable; onSkip reports "previous" or "next"; advance elapsed yourself with an every 1s when playing line).

props.doc: The name of your true/false variable: the center button flips it between play and pause.
The artist (and album), under the track.
The drawn art: vinyl, sunset or waves.
The art's palette: sand, rose, mint, sky, lilac or slate.

events.doc: Previous or next was tapped; the value is "previous" or "next".
